crossRefs.note: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:
This is the thing that you must do. A third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites…
So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they each took his men, those…
Let all things be done decently and in order.
These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
translations.bsb: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD, according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
translations.kjv: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
translations.asv: This was the ordering of them in their service, to come into the house of Jehovah according to the ordinance given unto them by Aaron their father, as Jehovah, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
